_readme: A split record, and worth reading as the example of what vendor-partial means.
ByteDance Seed's own product page establishes what the model IS - thirty seconds in
one pass, reference video understood as framing and cinematic intent, timestamp-level
editing. It publishes no parameter schema. BytePlus ModelArk, which does, serves its
documentation through client-side rendering and returned only navigation.
So the numbers - reference counts, the duration range, seed, audio - come from
Runware's model page and are recorded as what a PROVIDER accepts. Resolution is left
null on the model because the two sources disagree and neither is a model-level

sources.note: A PROVIDER source. Admissible for surface facts and, where flagged, for capability figures no vendor source publishes.

identity.note: ByteDance states 2.5 extends single-pass generation from 15 to 30 seconds, which is what establishes 2.0 as superseded.

capabilities.claim: Single-pass generation up to 30 seconds, extendable twice.
Multiple logically connected shots can be organised inside one generation.
Reference video is understood as intention, framing and cinematic language rather than motion to copy.
Timestamp-level control for targeted audio and video editing.
Frame images for first and last position.

capabilities.note: PROVIDER FIGURE; the 30 agrees with the vendor page.

capabilities.claim: Audio generation is supported and enabled by default.

capabilities.note: PROVIDER FIGURE. No ByteDance source read confirms it.

notEstablished.status: Runware serves 480p and 720p; ByteDance describes higher output. No vendor parameter list was read.
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: constraints.resolutions is null on the model and the 480p/720p ceiling is recorded against the Runware offering only.

notEstablished.status: Runware states frames are duration multiplied by the model's fps and does not disclose the fps
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: constraints.fps is null and no quantiser is asserted.

notEstablished.claim: The reference-citation syntax used in prompts.
notEstablished.status: ByteDance publishes a Seedance 2.5 prompt guide. It could not be retrieved.
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: promptPolicy.state is not-established. This is the single most consequential gap for this model - a reference-heavy model whose citation syntax is unknown cannot be compiled to, and no syntax has been guessed.

notEstablished.claim: Whether audio may be the only reference input.
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: No audioRequiresVisual rule is asserted for this family, unlike MiniMax H3 where the vendor states one.

conflicts.resolution: Neither written into the other. The provider's ceiling belongs to the provider; the model records nothing it cannot cite.
